title: comfy build push upload progress event
description: One JSON object per line while `comfy build push` uploads model files and packaged custom nodes. Under `--json-stream` the lines are on stdout, ahead of the final envelope (build_push.json schema in .data). Under `--json` they are on stderr, so stdout stays the single envelope. A push opens with one `upload_plan`; each file that transfers gets an `upload_progress` when it starts and about every two seconds after, then one `upload_complete`. A file the builder already held gets only an `upload_complete` with `deduplicated: true`. A file whose upload fails gets no `upload_complete`: the error envelope follows.

schema.description: Event contract version. Additive optional fields do not bump it; renamed/removed/retyped fields do.

type.description: ADVISORY and open-ended, as in run_event.json: ignore types you do not recognise.

files.description: upload_plan: files this push still has to send.

already_held.description: upload_plan: local models and nodes that need no upload, because an earlier push stored them or a public source link stands in for the bytes.

file.description: The model's filename, or `<node name>.zip` for a packaged custom node.

index.description: This file's position among the files being sent, from 1.

of.description: How many files are being sent.

bytes_done.description: upload_progress: bytes of this file handed to the connection so far.

bytes_total.description: upload_plan: bytes across every file to send. upload_progress / upload_complete: this file's size.

bytes_per_second.description: upload_progress: rate over the last ten seconds, so a stall reads as a falling number; null until two samples exist. upload_complete: the file's size over its whole transfer time; null when nothing was sent.

eta_seconds.description: upload_progress: seconds until this file finishes at the current rate; null while the rate is unknown or zero.

overall_bytes_done.description: Bytes accounted for across the whole push, counting files the builder already held.

overall_eta_seconds.description: upload_progress: seconds until every file finishes at the current rate.

seconds.description: upload_complete: how long this file's transfer took; 0 when deduplicated.

deduplicated.description: upload_complete: true when the builder already held these bytes and nothing was sent.
